title: DISASSEMBLY OF STEERING GEAR HOUSING
ocr_text:
SR-62

STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)

DISASSEMBLY OF STEERING GEAR HOUSING

1. CLAMP GEAR HOUSING IN VISE
Using SST, secure the steering gear in a vise.
SST 09612-00012

SST

SR1580

2. REMOVE RIGHT AND LEFT TURN PRESSURE TUBES
Using SST, remove the pressure tubes.
SST 09633-00020

SST

SR1581

3. REMOVE TIE ROD ENDS
(a) Loosen the clamp lock nut and place matchmarks on the tie rod tube and rack end.
(b) Remove the rod ends.

Matchmarks

D8338

4. REMOVE RACK BOOTS
(a) Remove the clips and clamps.
(b) Remove the rack boots.

5. REMOVE RACK ENDS AND CLAW WASHERS
(a) Unstake the claw washers.
NOTICE: Avoid any impact to the rack.

SR1582

(b) Using SST, remove the rack ends.
SST 09612-24014 (09617-24011)
09617-14010
(c) Remove the claw washers.

SST

SST

SR1537
